source.query:
SELECT
  countIf(viewed_count > 0) AS quiz_page_views,
  countIf(viewed_count > 0 AND started_count > 0 AND started_at >= viewed_at) AS quiz_starts,
  countIf(viewed_count > 0 AND started_count > 0 AND completed_count > 0
    AND started_at >= viewed_at AND completed_at >= started_at) AS quiz_completions,
  countIf(viewed_count > 0 AND started_count > 0 AND completed_count > 0 AND signup_count > 0
    AND started_at >= viewed_at AND completed_at >= started_at AND signup_at >= completed_at) AS signup_clicks,
  countIf(viewed_count > 0 AND started_count > 0 AND completed_count > 0 AND signup_count > 0
    AND started_at >= viewed_at AND completed_at >= started_at AND signup_at >= completed_at
    AND coalesce(p.auth_count, 0) > 0 AND p.auth_at >= signup_at) AS auth_started,
  countIf(viewed_count > 0 AND started_count > 0 AND completed_count > 0 AND signup_count > 0
    AND started_at >= viewed_at AND completed_at >= started_at AND signup_at >= completed_at
    AND coalesce(p.auth_count, 0) > 0 AND p.auth_at >= signup_at
    AND coalesce(p.account_count, 0) > 0 AND p.account_at >= p.auth_at) AS accounts_created,
  countIf(viewed_count > 0 AND started_count > 0 AND completed_count > 0 AND signup_count > 0
    AND started_at >= viewed_at AND completed_at >= started_at AND signup_at >= completed_at
    AND coalesce(p.auth_count, 0) > 0 AND p.auth_at >= signup_at
    AND coalesce(p.account_count, 0) > 0 AND p.account_at >= p.auth_at
    AND coalesce(p.onboarding_count, 0) > 0 AND p.onboarding_at >= p.account_at) AS onboarding_completed,
  countIf(viewed_count > 0 AND started_count > 0 AND completed_count > 0 AND signup_count > 0
    AND started_at >= viewed_at AND completed_at >= started_at AND signup_at >= completed_at
    AND coalesce(p.auth_count, 0) > 0 AND p.auth_at >= signup_at
    AND coalesce(p.account_count, 0) > 0 AND p.account_at >= p.auth_at
    AND coalesce(p.onboarding_count, 0) > 0 AND p.onboarding_at >= p.account_at
    AND coalesce(p.match_count, 0) > 0 AND p.match_at >= p.onboarding_at) AS first_matches
FROM (
  SELECT
    properties.campaign_conversion_id AS conversion_id,
    properties.quiz_slug AS quiz_slug,
    countIf(event = 'campaign_quiz_page_view') AS viewed_count,
    countIf(event = 'quiz_start') AS started_count,
    countIf(event = 'quiz_complete') AS completed_count,
    countIf(event = 'signup_click') AS signup_count,
    minIf(timestamp, event = 'campaign_quiz_page_view') AS viewed_at,
    minIf(timestamp, event = 'quiz_start') AS started_at,
    minIf(timestamp, event = 'quiz_complete') AS completed_at,
    minIf(timestamp, event = 'signup_click') AS signup_at,
    anyIf(person_id, event = 'signup_click') AS signup_person
  FROM events
  WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
    AND coalesce(person.properties.email, '') NOT IN ('tazigrigolia@gmail.com','nikusha13.talakhadze@gmail.com','kevlishvilikonstantine660@gmail.com','eloshaman@gmail.com','giunaabramishvili@gmail.com','quizball2026@gmail.com')
    AND event IN ('campaign_quiz_page_view', 'quiz_start', 'quiz_complete', 'signup_click')
    AND properties.campaign_conversion_id IS NOT NULL AND properties.campaign_conversion_id != ''
    AND properties.quiz_slug IS NOT NULL AND properties.quiz_slug != ''
    AND properties['$host'] = 'quizball.io' AND properties.quiz_type = 'campaign'
  GROUP BY conversion_id, quiz_slug
) conv
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT person_id,
    countIf(event = 'auth_started') AS auth_count,
    minIf(timestamp, event = 'auth_started') AS auth_at,
    countIf(event = 'account_created') AS account_count,
    minIf(timestamp, event = 'account_created') AS account_at,
    countIf(event = 'onboarding_completed') AS onboarding_count,
    minIf(timestamp, event = 'onboarding_completed') AS onboarding_at,
    countIf(event = 'match_started') AS match_count,
    minIf(timestamp, event = 'match_started') AS match_at
  FROM events
  WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
    AND event IN ('auth_started', 'account_created', 'onboarding_completed', 'match_started')
    AND coalesce(person.properties.email, '') NOT IN ('tazigrigolia@gmail.com','nikusha13.talakhadze@gmail.com','kevlishvilikonstantine660@gmail.com','eloshaman@gmail.com','giunaabramishvili@gmail.com','quizball2026@gmail.com')
  GROUP BY person_id
) p ON p.person_id = conv.signup_person

source.query: SELECT toDate(timestamp) AS day, uniqExactIf(toString(properties.match_id), properties.mode='ranked') AS ranked, uniqExactIf(toString(properties.match_id), properties.mode='auction') AS auction, uniqExactIf(toString(properties.match_id), properties.mode='friendly') AS friendly, uniqExact(toString(properties.match_id)) AS total FROM events WHERE event='match_completed' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

SELECT toStartOfMonth(timestamp) AS month, uniqExactIf(toString(properties.match_id), properties.mode='ranked') AS ranked, uniqExactIf(toString(properties.match_id), properties.mode='auction') AS auction, uniqExactIf(toString(properties.match_id), properties.mode='friendly') AS friendly, uniqExact(toString(properties.match_id)) AS total FROM events WHERE event='match_completed' AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-05-01 00:00:00') GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

SELECT toString(properties.mode) AS mode, uniqExact(toString(properties.match_id)) AS matches, count() AS player_participations FROM events WHERE event='match_completed' AND toDate(timestamp)=today() GROUP BY mode ORDER BY matches DESC

SELECT toString(properties.mode) AS mode, uniqExact(toString(properties.match_id)) AS matches, round(100.0 * uniqExact(toString(properties.match_id)) / (SELECT uniqExact(toString(properties.match_id)) FROM events WHERE event='match_completed' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY), 1) AS pct_of_all FROM events WHERE event='match_completed' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY mode ORDER BY matches DESC

games.name: Daily challenges completed per day by type

source.query: SELECT toDate(timestamp) AS day, countIf(properties.challenge_type='moneyDrop') AS moneyDrop, countIf(properties.challenge_type='countdown') AS countdown, countIf(properties.challenge_type='trueFalse') AS trueFalse, countIf(properties.challenge_type='careerPath') AS careerPath, countIf(properties.challenge_type='imposter') AS imposter, countIf(properties.challenge_type='highLow') AS highLow, count() AS total FROM events WHERE event='daily_challenge_completed' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

games.name: Daily challenge completion rate by type (30d)

source.query: SELECT toString(properties.challenge_type) AS challenge, countIf(event='daily_challenge_started') AS started, countIf(event='daily_challenge_completed') AS completed, countIf(event='daily_challenge_quit') AS quit, round(100.0 * countIf(event='daily_challenge_completed') / nullIf(countIf(event='daily_challenge_started'),0), 1) AS completion_pct FROM events WHERE event IN ('daily_challenge_started','daily_challenge_completed','daily_challenge_quit') AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY challenge ORDER BY started DESC

SELECT toStartOfMonth(timestamp) AS month, count() AS completions, count(DISTINCT person_id) AS unique_players FROM events WHERE event='daily_challenge_completed' AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-05-01 00:00:00') GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

SELECT toDate(timestamp) AS day, uniqExactIf(toString(properties.lobby_id), event='lobby_created') AS lobbies_created, uniqExactIf(toString(properties.lobby_id), event='lobby_joined') AS lobbies_joined, uniqExactIf(person_id, event='lobby_joined') AS people_joining FROM events WHERE event IN ('lobby_created','lobby_joined') AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
